english: Laura?\nSleeping propped up like that...
Halt!\nOne step closer and...
Eep...!
Did you forget?\nIt's [CLAUDE].
No, I do remember, more or less.\nI believe I've seen you.
What are you doing there?\nDepending on your answer, you won't walk away unscathed.
Schwarzer Regen\nwill crush you.
I-I'm sorry...\nCould you lower that IS's arm...?
...Very well.\nNow, what are you up to?
Did you think I was asleep and go for my neck?
I wouldn't do that!\nUm...\nyou looked tired, so I was just going to call out to you...
Hm...\nSo you're the kind of man who calls out to a sleeping woman...
All the more reason I can't let my guard down around you.
I was resting, yes,\nbut I never dropped my guard.
One more step and\nyou'd have been a charred corpse.
Charred...\nCome on, you don't need to be that on guard...\nAren't we allies already?
...\nI can't say for sure everyone's my ally.
Especially with the likes of you —\nvigilance is the only option.
Oh, come on~!\nI wouldn't do anything like that.
...And I'm supposed to believe that?\nUnlikely.
So I'm still not your ally...\nThat's a little sad...
No need to look so down.\nIt's just a question of whether\nI can trust you.
...That's how it is...\nGive it up...
Huh? You raised that IS arm —\nis something wrong...?
I still can't believe you're my ally.\nAnd I can't rule out\nthat you're in disguise.
So I'll test you.\nYou've already survived fighting me.\nSurely you can handle this much.
Wh-whoa, that was close!!\nWhat if that had hit me!?
...You dodged it?\nI wasn't serious, but...\nat this range...
You...
(Her eyes are terrifying!!\nGotta get away before she shoots again!!)
W-wait!!\nOr I'll shoot!!
It dodged again...?
(Eeeek...\nHow did it come to this...)
Found you...\nPerfect timing.
Huh? Wh-what is it?\nI'm... um... busy, so...
No running.\nThis time I'll hit you for real.
It's nothing much —\nI just want to ask you two or three questions.
Clear my suspicions\nand I'll let you go at once.
Then, I ask:\nare you confident in your running?
My running...?\nThat much, I have...\n...More or less.
I see.\nIs that some kind of ability?
Don't tell me...\nyou can use an IS?
There's no precedent\nfor a man using an IS...\nbut from another world, there's no way to check.
I thought maybe\nyou used instant acceleration\nwhen you dodged my cannon fire.
Otherwise, there's no way\nyou could've dodged my attack from that position.
Igni... huh? What's that...?\nI don't really understand, but...\nI don't have an IS, and I don't have that kind of power.
Not instant acceleration!?\nThen how...?
Even if I wasn't serious,\nthat was no attack you could just dodge.
...Fascinating.
Um... I just sensed the danger.\nRan for dear life... that's all.
Hm...\nThat too is a fine ability.\nSomething attacks can't hit is a threat.
Maybe... it just missed?\nThe barrel was off, or...
Mock Schwarzer Regen\nand I won't forgive you.
My attack was perfect.\nOf that there is no doubt.
One... favor. Will you do it?
Wh-what is it...?
I want some of your time later.\nThere's something I want to try.
...Refusal is not accepted.\nDon't run.
If you try to flee,\nI'll hunt you down with everything I've got.
Understood...\nI couldn't run anyway...
(...I have nothing but... bad feelings about this.)
Well, that'll do for today.\nLater.
Well.\nYou've come as promised.
So... you know what this is about?
Um... I'd rather not know...\nYou're not planning to shoot me, are you?
Don't make it sound so bad.\nYou're good at dodging, right?\nSo let me practice my artillery on you.
There's a big difference\nbetween aiming at a still target\nand one that can't be hit.
Which makes you the perfect target.
...That doesn't make me happy at all.
You're the only one\nI can ask this of.
What do you say?\nWill you do it?
Fine...\nBut go easy on me, okay...
I'll be as careful as I can.\nThe danger won't fully go away, but...\nyou'll be fine.
What if I say no?
Then it can't be helped...\nFor defying me,\nSchwarzer Regen will blow you to smithereens.
So... either way,\nI'm getting shot at...?
...You noticed?\nQuite clever.
Begin.\nDodge for your life!
...You dodged again.\nTo think MY shots could be dodged like this...
You're the real deal, then.
Next!
Whoa!\nThat nearly grazed me!?
It didn't graze you, did it...\n?\nAnd here I am shooting every one with intent to hit.
Then how about this?
Whaaat!?\nNobody said anything about close combat!!
You left an opening!
...!?\nThat was close...!\nWhat if it had hit me!?
...This one too.\nEven I'm starting to lose confidence...
Well, whatever.\nThis was enough of a test.
No IS power,\nyet your mobility spikes when you dodge...
As a research subject...\nyou might do nicely.\nRight, next I'll—
S-sorry!\nI'm a little busy, so... bye!
W-wait!\nI won't treat you badly!\nYou'll be guaranteed proper treatment.
(Being your research subject sounds WAY worse!)
Moe... what is it?
...Where did that come from?
Mhm.\nThere's a concept in this world called moe, no?\nAnd it's supposedly one of Japan's proudest cultures...
I heard it while with the German army.\nDon't underestimate my intelligence network.
That's quite the biased source...\nWho told you that...?
That's none of your concern.\nNow, teach me moe.\nDon't think you have the right to refuse.
It's a culture Germany lacks.\nIf Japan has such a thing,\nI shall learn it.
Moe... it's hard to explain...\nF-for example... Dejiko, maybe...
What? That cat-eared girl?\nWhat about her?
I think a lot of people\nfeel moe when they look at Dejiko...
I don't follow.\nI demand a more concrete explanation.
Or is moe a concept\nonly Japanese can understand?
I don't think that's the case... probably.
For example...\nif YOU wore cat ears, Laura...
M-me?\nImitating that cat-eared girl?
...Mhm. If that is moe,\nthen becoming it myself...\nstands to reason...
Probably... it's close to 'cute', I think...
Then just say cute.\nNo need for other words.
I still don't quite get it.\nIf only there were something easier\nfor me to grasp...
...My waifu...
...What?\nSomething wrong with a wife?
My wife is Hibiki, that's decided.\nI will never give her up.
That's... probably similar.\nWhat you feel for Hibiki right now.
That might be close to the feeling of moe...
This is... moe.\nThen I've been feeling it all along.
I don't want to break her...\nbut I feel an urge to break her all the same.
But then there's the contradiction —\nwanting her all to myself,\nyet wanting to watch Hibiki be free.
...I see.\nThis complicated feeling... is moe.
Japanese culture...\nis a strange thing...
(It's hard to define, so...\nI don't know if that's right...)
Mhm...
What are you agonizing over with your arms crossed?
...Which of these is better.\nThat's what I'm agonizing over.
They're hair ornaments...\nBlue... or pink...\nIt's difficult...
Which one suits her...
Even you agonize over things, Laura.
What do you take me for.\nI agonize like anyone else.
I just avoid wasting time\nas much as possible.
Normally I'd decide\nin an instant, but...
Somehow, I can't.\nI'm feeling that moe thing\nyou taught me the other day.
(Huh? Moe for hair ornaments?\nShe's using it a little wrong...)
Both are bound to be cute.\nWhat should I do in that case...
When torn between two things,\nwhat would you do?
When I really can't choose...\nI get both.
Normally I'd do the same.\nBut... to borrow a phrase...\nyou have no restraint...
(Wh-why... am I being shot down?)
I'd think about which one suits her...
Which suits her...\nthe same situation I'm in.\nRight now in my head I'm picturing her wearing each hair clip, narrowing it down.
And that's what I'm torn about.
This one suits her... I'm sure.
Wh-what are you doing!\nI don't wear hair clips...
H-hey! Don't just put it on me!
Look, it suits you really well, Laura.
Enough.\nI don't wear hair clips to begin with...
But you were agonizing over the hair clips, right?\nThat's what I heard.
I was, but...\nthese aren't mine, they're for my wife...
...\nYou look really cute, Laura.
M-me? That doesn't matter...!\nI was picking something to give my wife!
M-me, cute...?\nNo! My wife is far cuter!\nI can say that with certainty!
Ah, it's a present for Hibiki...\nI thought it was for you...
Well, still...\nI see...\nIf that's your opinion, I'll give Hibiki the other one.
I thought this one\nsuited Hibiki better anyway.
That was valuable input.\nMy thanks.
(Laura... thanking me...?\nNo, it's not weird, but...\nI didn't expect it from her...)
If you were going on a date,\nwhere would you take her?
...That's sudden...
The point got across.\nThat's enough...
Or do you need an explanation?\nI'd rather skip such trouble.\nFine.
Suppose you...\nsay...\nwere lucky enough to go out with a certain woman.
For you, it'd be\nthe stage of a lifetime.
You don't have to go that far...
No need to posture.\nHear it as a hypothetical.\nA fantasy.
When you decide where to go,\nwhere would it be?
...That's hard...
Obviously.\nOtherwise I wouldn't be agonizing over it.
The movies, maybe...?\nIt's the classic choice.
I see, that was a candidate.\nBut in that case...\ndoesn't what comes after depend on the movie you pick?
Ah...!\nYou're right...
You hadn't thought that far...\nThat won't do.
How about an amusement park...?
True... that could work.\nBecause you can enjoy it together.
Mhm... I see.\nThat's the extent of your ideas...
If that'd make her happy, fine...\nHm, well...\nClarissa mentioned those as candidates too...
Also... how about an arcade?
An arcade?\nFor a date?\nI have no such data...
Is that really an option?\nYou're not trying to trick me, are you?
I-I wouldn't do that...\nYou're precise with IS controls,\nso I thought it might suit you...
...\nI see.\nNot just matching the other person, but mixing in my own strengths...
That... may indeed be an effective move.
Mhm. Understood.\nI'll take it under advisement.
...I'll confirm with Clarissa too...
(...That was a date question, but...\nwho is she planning to ask out?)
(...The opposite sex... that's just me, right.\nCould this be... an invitation for me?\n...No way.)
Huh? Laura's asleep again.\nW-wait... am I inside her range!?
Ah, um, this is... I mean.\nI didn't notice...\nI didn't mean to step into range...
...You?\nI fell asleep without realizing...
Hm? What's wrong?\nCovering your face.\nWhat's the idea?
Huh...?\nDidn't you say you'd attack with your IS if someone entered your range while you slept...?
...Relax.\nI won't attack over that anymore.
Unless you get REALLY close...
Though...\nmy attacks don't hit you anyway.
So being on guard\nis meaningless anyway.
N-no... it might hit next time...
Shall we try...?\n...Well, we can test that another time.\nMore importantly...
Because allies are nearby...?\nThat I can sleep so defenselessly...
(Just now, Laura...\n'allies'... she means me, right...)
...Unthinkable not long ago.\nTo go so soft in such a short time.
Soft...? That's not it.\nThat's... trust.
Trust...\nAptly put... I don't hate it.
Let's leave it at that.
By the way, do you need something from me?
About that date talk the other day...
That's nothing\nfor you to worry about.
It's all my business.
(...Is Laura saying...\nshe'll invite me...?)
You were sleeping here...\nI thought it'd be bad if you caught a cold.
I see. You were worried about me.\nBut... I'm fine.\nI won't catch a cold from this.
Sorry, but let me sleep a little longer.
...I must've been too on edge...\n............
...She's already asleep...\nShe must be really tired...
There might be an invitation coming...\nuntil then, I'll pretend I don't know.
H-hey...\nIt's time... Wake up.
Time...?\nDid we have something...?\nHuh? Laura, that outfit?
G-go ahead and laugh if you want!\nI didn't plan on dressing like this.
...I won't laugh.\nIt suits you really well.
I see! Th-that's... well.\nToday's special, you know...\nThis outfit is... just for today.
Let's move to the café.\nWe're blocking the way.
Here's the menu.\nOrder what you like.
But... my recommendation is oden.
...Oden... at a café?
Objecting?\nIt's a well-liked meal in Japan, no?
I prepared it based on that information.
If you object, you don't have to order...
N-no. I'll have it.\nThe oden.
A wise decision.\nI'll bring it right out.
Here.
...\nSkewered — an old-fashioned, classic presentation...
I learned it from a book.\nIt shows up a lot in Japanese manga,\nso I found it right away.
It's that beloved, then.
(...Did she reference a slightly old manga...)
So... how is it?\nThe taste of my oden.
It's really delicious.
I-I see! Then good.\nEat as much as you like.
I've caused you a lot of trouble...\nThis is my apology...
An apology... I'm happy.\nTo have someone as cute as you do this for me.
C-cu... cuuut...\nG-gahh! Wh-what are you saying!!
A-again... What's wrong with me lately...?\nI can't calm down... What did you do to me?
Is this your...\nOne-Off Ability...?
This power is unfair... Neutralizing me...\nIt must not be!
You're... my wife too.\nFrom now on, you're my wife as well! No objections!
I am... your...
Hm...? Where...?\nI fell asleep here...
There's being defenseless, and then there's this.
Laura!?\nHuh...? You're in uniform...
Obviously.\nI wear this most of the time.
Still half-asleep, are you.
Wh-what... it was a dream...\nWhat a shame...
Now...\nthere's something I need to tell you.
Y-yes.
(...An invitation?)
Thanks to you, it went well.\nMy thanks.
I was able to ask Hibiki on a date.\nI gave her the hair clip, and she was happy.
Look.\nI wear one, and Hibiki wears the other.\nIt's what they call matching.
With this, Hibiki is even more my wife.
Huh? All of that was... for Hibiki?\nThen what about me?\nTo you, Laura... what am I?
Don't ask strange things.\nI've never thought about it, but...
If Hibiki is my wife,\nthen you...
are my neighbor.
N-neighbor...!?\nNo way...
That's all for my report.\nIf anything comes up, I'll consult you again.
(Seriously...\nI really jumped to conclusions there...)
